body:
Hey BLA :)

How do you handle the i18n on your side? Is that:

* Only defined through the browser locale and not changeable?
* A dropdown in the UI that changes the displayed language of the UI (but still use the same results from Algolia)
* A dropdown in the UI that change the index/filters of the results to target those of a specific language?

Depending on the use case there are several ways to do that, but most of them will involve defining a function as the template. If you define a function, it will be called on each render and you can then dynamically chose which error message to display.
